requirements.display_name: Vehicle-specific replacement engine air cleaner filter

actions.title: Switch the engine off
actions.instruction: Switch the engine off and allow the engine compartment to become safe to work around before opening the air-cleaner housing.

actions.title: Unlock and open the air-cleaner cover
actions.instruction: Operate the air-cleaner cover locking lever to the UNLOCK position and open the housing.

actions.title: Remove the old air cleaner filter
actions.instruction: Lift out the used filter without allowing loose dirt to fall into the clean side of the intake.
actions.warning_text: Do not operate the vehicle with the air-cleaner filter removed.

actions.title: Wipe dirt from the inside of the air-cleaner housing
actions.instruction: Wipe loose dirt from the housing while keeping debris out of the intake path.

actions.title: Install the replacement air cleaner filter
actions.instruction: Seat the correct replacement filter fully in the housing.

actions.title: Close and lock the air-cleaner cover
actions.instruction: Close the air-cleaner housing and return its locking lever to the LOCK position. Check that the cover is fully secured.
